The linked explorer shows the affected rows. Missing-field counts can overlap.

Follow Older discoveries to review observations more than 30 days before the snapshot.

One CI can require several checks; CIs without required mappings are outside the percentage.

Return to the briefing and Generate PDF to share the evidence and next steps.
